{"step_index":679,"source":"MODEL","type":"PLANNER_RESPONSE","status":"DONE","created_at":"2026-07-10T12:35:10Z","content":"Template compile OK. Bây giờ viết lại engine chấm thuần JavaScript (không cần OpenCV.js):","tool_calls":[{"name":"write_to_file","args":{"CodeContent":"/**\n * omr_engine.js – Pure JS OMR Engine (Zero dependencies!)\n * Thay thế hoàn toàn OpenCV.js. Chạy ngay, không cần tải WASM.\n *\n * Thuật toán:\n *  1. Tìm 4 điểm neo góc bằng pixel scanning\n *  2. Tính ma trận Homography 3×3 (Gaussian elimination)\n *  3. Warp perspective ngược (inverse mapping)\n *  4. Đọc độ tối từng ô tròn (ROI pixel counting)\n */\n\n// ==========================================\n// 1. CORNER DETECTION\n// ==========================================\n\n/**\n * Scan 1/4 góc của ảnh để tìm cụm pixel đen lớn nhất (= điểm neo marker)\n * @param {Uint8ClampedArray} data – RGBA pixel array\n * @param {number} W, H – image dimensions\n * @param {'tl'|'tr'|'bl'|'br'} corner\n * @returns {[number, number]} – centroid [cx, cy]\n */\nfunction findMarker(data, W, H, corner) {\n  const THRESHOLD = 80; // Pixel tối hơn ngưỡng này = black marker\n  const QUAD_X = corner.includes('r') ? 0.55 : 0;\n  const QUAD_Y = corner.includes('b') ? 0.55 : 0;\n  const xStart = Math.floor(W * QUAD_X);\n  const xEnd   = Math.floor(W * (QUAD_X + 0.45));\n  const yStart = Math.floor(H * QUAD_Y);\n  const yEnd   = Math.floor(H * (QUAD_Y + 0.45));\n\n  // Find bounding box of largest dark cluster in quadrant\n  let sumX = 0, sumY = 0, count = 0;\n  let minX = xEnd, maxX = xStart, minY = yEnd, maxY = yStart;\n\n  for (let y = yStart; y < yEnd; y++) {\n    for (let x = xStart; x < xEnd; x++) {\n      const idx = (y * W + x) * 4;\n      const gray = 0.299 * data[idx] + 0.587 * data[idx+1] + 0.114 * data[idx+2];\n      if (gray < THRESHOLD) {\n        sumX += x; sumY += y; count++;\n        if (x < minX) minX = x; if (x > maxX) maxX = x;\n        if (y < minY) minY = y; if (y > maxY) maxY = y;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  if (count < 50) return null;\n  // Use centroid of the main dark cluster (filter outliers by staying near centroid)\n  const cxRaw = sumX / count, cyRaw = sumY / count;\n  return [cxRaw, cyRaw];\n}\n\n// ==========================================\n// 2. HOMOGRAPHY (4-point perspective warp)\n// ==========================================\n\n/** Gaussian elimination to solve Ax = b (augmented matrix [A|b]) */\nfunction gaussianElimination(A) {\n  const n = A.length;\n  for (let col = 0; col < n; col++) {\n    // Pivot\n    let maxRow = col;\n    for (let row = col+1; row < n; row++) {\n      if (Math.abs(A[row][col]) > Math.abs(A[maxRow][col])) maxRow = row;\n    }\n    [A[col], A[maxRow]] = [A[maxRow], A[col]];\n    if (Math.abs(A[col][col]) < 1e-12) continue;\n    for (let row = 0; row < n; row++) {\n      if (row === col) continue;\n      const factor = A[row][col] / A[col][col];\n      for (let j = col; j <= n; j++) A[row][j] -= factor * A[col][j];\n    }\n  }\n  return A.map((row, i) => row[n] / row[i]);\n}\n\n/**\n * Compute 3×3 homography from 4 source points to 4 destination points.\n * src, dst: [[x0,y0],[x1,y1],[x2,y2],[x3,y3]]\n */\nfunction computeHomography(src, dst) {\n  const A = [];\n  for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {\n    const [sx, sy] = src[i];\n    const [dx, dy] = dst[i];\n    A.push([-sx, -sy, -1,  0,   0,  0,  dx*sx, dx*sy, dx]);\n    A.push([ 0,   0,  0, -sx, -sy, -1,  dy*sx, dy*sy, dy]);\n  }\n  const h = gaussianElimination(A);\n  return [\n    [h[0], h[1], h[2]],\n    [h[3], h[4], h[5]],\n    [h[6], h[7], 1.0 ]\n  ];\n}\n\n/** Invert a 3×3 matrix */\nfunction invertMatrix3(m) {\n  const [[a,b,c],[d,e,f],[g,h,k]] = m;\n  const det = a*(e*k-f*h) - b*(d*k-f*g) + c*(d*h-e*g);\n  if (Math.abs(det) < 1e-12) return null;\n  const inv = 1/det;\n  return [\n    [(e*k-f*h)*inv, (c*h-b*k)*inv, (b*f-c*e)*inv],\n    [(f*g-d*k)*inv, (a*k-c*g)*inv, (c*d-a*f)*inv],\n    [(d*h-e*g)*inv, (b*g-a*h)*inv, (a*e-b*d)*inv]\n  ];\n}\n\n/** Apply homography H to point (x,y) */\nfunction applyH(H, x, y) {\n  const [[h0,h1,h2],[h3,h4,h5],[h6,h7,h8]] = H;\n  const w = h6*x + h7*y + h8;\n  return [(h0*x + h1*y + h2)/w, (h3*x + h4*y + h5)/w];\n}\n\n// ==========================================\n// 3. WARP PERSPECTIVE (inverse mapping)\n// ==========================================\n\n/**\n * Warp source image to a dstW×dstH rectangle.\n * srcCorners: [tl, tr, br, bl] as [[x,y], ...]\n * Returns new ImageData\n */\nfunction warpPerspective(srcImageData, srcCorners, dstW, dstH) {\n  const srcW = srcImageData.width, srcH = srcImageData.height;\n  const srcData = srcImageData.data;\n  const dstCorners = [[0,0],[dstW,0],[dstW,dstH],[0,dstH]];\n\n  const H     = computeHomography(srcCorners, dstCorners);\n  const Hinv  = invertMatrix3(H);\n  if (!Hinv) throw new Error(\"Singular homography matrix\");\n\n  const out = new Uint8ClampedArray(dstW * dstH * 4);\n\n  for (let dy = 0; dy < dstH; dy++) {\n    for (let dx = 0; dx < dstW; dx++) {\n      const [sx, sy] = applyH(Hinv, dx, dy);\n      const ix = Math.round(sx), iy = Math.round(sy);\n      const dstIdx = (dy * dstW + dx) * 4;\n      if (ix >= 0 && ix < srcW && iy >= 0 && iy < srcH) {\n        const srcIdx = (iy * srcW + ix) * 4;\n        out[dstIdx]   = srcData[srcIdx];\n        out[dstIdx+1] = srcData[srcIdx+1];\n        out[dstIdx+2] = srcData[srcIdx+2];\n        out[dstIdx+3] = 255;\n      } else {\n        out[dstIdx] = out[dstIdx+1] = out[dstIdx+2] = 255;\n        out[dstIdx+3] = 255;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  return new ImageData(out, dstW, dstH);\n}\n\n// ==========================================\n// 4. BUBBLE READING\n// ==========================================\n\n/**\n * Count dark pixels in a circular ROI on a binary (inverted) image.\n * @param {Uint8ClampedArray} data – grayscale (R channel used)\n * @param {number} W – image width\n * @param {number} cx, cy – center\n * @param {number} radius\n * @param {number} threshold – pixel < threshold → dark\n * @returns {number} – ratio 0.0–1.0 of dark pixels\n */\nfunction readBubbleDarkness(data, W, cx, cy, radius, threshold = 150) {\n  let dark = 0, total = 0;\n  const r2 = radius * radius;\n  for (let dy = -radius; dy <= radius; dy++) {\n    for (let dx = -radius; dx <= radius; dx++) {\n      if (dx*dx + dy*dy > r2) continue;\n      const px = Math.round(cx + dx), py = Math.round(cy + dy);\n      if (px < 0 || py < 0 || px >= W) continue;\n      const idx = (py * W + px) * 4;\n      const gray = 0.299*data[idx] + 0.587*data[idx+1] + 0.114*data[idx+2];\n      total++;\n      if (gray < threshold) dark++;\n    }\n  }\n  return total > 0 ? dark / total : 0;\n}\n\n/** Read which digit (0-9) is filled in a column of 10 bubbles */\nfunction readDigitColumn(grayData, W, coords, radius = 6) {\n  const darkRatios = coords.map((pt, row) => ({\n    row,\n    dark: readBubbleDarkness(grayData, W, pt[0], pt[1], radius)\n  }));\n  const best = darkRatios.reduce((a, b) => a.dark > b.dark ? a : b);\n  return best.dark > 0.12 ? { digit: best.row.toString(), confidence: best.dark } : { digit: '?', confidence: 0 };\n}\n\n/** Read A/B/C/D bubble for a single MCQ row (4 options) */\nfunction readMCQRow(grayData, W, pts, radius = 6) {\n  const options = ['A','B','C','D'];\n  const darks = pts.map((pt, i) => ({\n    opt: options[i],\n    dark: readBubbleDarkness(grayData, W, pt[0], pt[1], radius)\n  }));\n  const best = darks.reduce((a,b) => a.dark > b.dark ? a : b);\n  return best.dark > 0.12 ? { answer: best.opt, confidence: best.dark, all: darks } : { answer: '', confidence: 0, all: darks };\n}\n\n/** Read Đúng/Sai pair (Đ/S) for a single statement */\nfunction readTFBubble(grayData, W, ptD, ptS, radius = 6) {\n  const dD = readBubbleDarkness(grayData, W, ptD[0], ptD[1], radius);\n  const dS = readBubbleDarkness(grayData, W, ptS[0], ptS[1], radius);\n  if (dD < 0.12 && dS < 0.12) return { answer: '', dD, dS };\n  return { answer: dD > dS ? 'Đ' : 'S', dD, dS };\n}\n\n// ==========================================\n// 5. MAIN GRADING FUNCTION\n// ==========================================\n\n/**\n * Grade an image element using template coordinates.\n * @param {HTMLImageElement} imgEl\n * @param {object} template – coordinate template\n * @param {object} answerKey – { mcq: {1:'A',...}, tf: {13: {a:'Đ',...}}, tln: {17:'2.5',...} }\n * @param {HTMLCanvasElement} outputCanvas – canvas to display result\n * @returns {object} result\n */\nfunction gradeOMR(imgEl, template, answerKey, outputCanvas) {\n  // Draw image to offscreen canvas to get pixel data\n  const WARP_W = 700, WARP_H = 1050; // 2:3 ratio\n\n  const offscreen = document.createElement('canvas');\n  offscreen.width = imgEl.naturalWidth;\n  offscreen.height = imgEl.naturalHeight;\n  const octx = offscreen.getContext('2d');\n  octx.drawImage(imgEl, 0, 0);\n  const srcData = octx.getImageData(0, 0, offscreen.width, offscreen.height);\n\n  // 1. Find 4 corner markers\n  const W = srcData.width, H = srcData.height;\n  const tl = findMarker(srcData.data, W, H, 'tl');\n  const tr = findMarker(srcData.data, W, H, 'tr');\n  const br = findMarker(srcData.data, W, H, 'br');\n  const bl = findMarker(srcData.data, W, H, 'bl');\n\n  if (!tl || !tr || !br || !bl) {\n    throw new Error(\"Không tìm thấy đủ 4 góc định vị OMR.\\nKiểm tra: ảnh đủ sáng, 4 hình vuông đen ở 4 góc trang.\");\n  }\n\n  // 2. Warp perspective\n  const warpedData = warpPerspective(srcData, [tl, tr, br, bl], WARP_W, WARP_H);\n\n  // 3. Scale template coordinates (template calibrated on 1000×1500)\n  const scaleX = WARP_W / 1000, scaleY = WARP_H / 1500;\n  function sc(pt) { return [Math.round(pt[0]*scaleX), Math.round(pt[1]*scaleY)]; }\n\n  // 4. Display warped image on output canvas\n  outputCanvas.width = WARP_W;\n  outputCanvas.height = WARP_H;\n  const rctx = outputCanvas.getContext('2d');\n  rctx.putImageData(warpedData, 0, 0);\n\n  // 5. Read digit grid data\n  const gData = warpedData.data;\n\n  // Read SBD (4 digits)\n  const sbdDigits = [];\n  for (let col = 0; col < template.numSbd; col++) {\n    const colCoords = template.sbd.map(row => sc(row[col]));\n    const { digit } = readDigitColumn(gData, WARP_W, colCoords, 5);\n    sbdDigits.push(digit);\n  }\n\n  // Read Mã đề (3 digits)\n  const madeDigits = [];\n  for (let col = 0; col < template.numMade; col++) {\n    const colCoords = template.made.map(row => sc(row[col]));\n    const { digit } = readDigitColumn(gData, WARP_W, colCoords, 5);\n    madeDigits.push(digit);\n  }\n\n  // 6. Read MCQ part (A/B/C/D)\n  let mcqCorrect = 0, mcqTotal = Object.keys(template.mcq || {}).length;\n  const mcqAnswers = {};\n  rctx.lineWidth = 2.5;\n  for (const [qStr, pts] of Object.entries(template.mcq || {})) {\n    const scaledPts = pts.map(sc);\n    const { answer, all } = readMCQRow(gData, WARP_W, scaledPts, 6);\n    mcqAnswers[qStr] = answer;\n    const expected = (answerKey.mcq || {})[qStr] || '';\n    const isCorrect = answer && answer === expected;\n    if (isCorrect) mcqCorrect++;\n\n    if (answer) {\n      const filledPt = scaledPts[['A','B','C','D'].indexOf(answer)];\n      rctx.strokeStyle = isCorrect ? '#00cc44' : '#ff2222';\n      rctx.beginPath(); rctx.arc(filledPt[0], filledPt[1], 9, 0, Math.PI*2); rctx.stroke();\n      if (!isCorrect && expected) {\n        const ei = ['A','B','C','D'].indexOf(expected);\n        if (ei >= 0) {\n          rctx.strokeStyle = '#3399ff';\n          rctx.beginPath(); rctx.arc(scaledPts[ei][0], scaledPts[ei][1], 9, 0, Math.PI*2); rctx.stroke();\n        }\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  // 7. Read True/False part (Đ/S)\n  let tfPoints = 0, tfTotal = 0;\n  const tfAnswers = {};\n  for (const [qStr, mds] of Object.entries(template.tf || {})) {\n    tfAnswers[qStr] = {};\n    let qCorrect = 0, qTotal = mds.length;\n    for (let mi = 0; mi < mds.length; mi++) {\n      const [ptD, ptS] = [sc(mds[mi][0]), sc(mds[mi][1])];\n      const { answer } = readTFBubble(gData, WARP_W, ptD, ptS, 5);\n      const label = ['a','b','c','d'][mi];\n      tfAnswers[qStr][label] = answer;\n      const expectedTF = ((answerKey.tf || {})[qStr] || {})[label] || '';\n      const ok = answer && answer === expectedTF;\n      if (ok) qCorrect++;\n      tfTotal++;\n\n      // Draw result\n      if (answer) {\n        const pt = answer === 'Đ' ? ptD : ptS;\n        rctx.strokeStyle = ok ? '#00cc44' : '#ff2222';\n        rctx.beginPath(); rctx.arc(pt[0], pt[1], 7, 0, Math.PI*2); rctx.stroke();\n      }\n    }\n    // Scoring per question: 0/1/2/3/4 correct → 0/0.1/0.25/0.5/1.0 per question\n    const scoreMap = [0, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1.0];\n    tfPoints += scoreMap[qCorrect] || 0;\n  }\n\n  // 8. Read TLN (fill-in-number)\n  let tlnCorrect = 0, tlnTotal = Object.keys(template.tln || {}).length;\n  const tlnAnswers = {};\n  for (const [qStr, colGroups] of Object.entries(template.tln || {})) {\n    // colGroups: [int4cols, dec2cols] each is array of 10 rows × n cols\n    const intPart = [], decPart = [];\n    for (let col = 0; col < colGroups.int.length; col++) {\n      const coords = colGroups.int.map(row => sc(row[col]));\n      intPart.push(readDigitColumn(gData, WARP_W, coords, 5).digit);\n    }\n    for (let col = 0; col < colGroups.dec.length; col++) {\n      const coords = colGroups.dec.map(row => sc(row[col]));\n      decPart.push(readDigitColumn(gData, WARP_W, coords, 5).digit);\n    }\n    const val = intPart.filter(d=>d!=='?').join('').replace(/^0+/,'') || '0';\n    const dec = decPart.filter(d=>d!=='?').join('').replace(/0+$/,'') || '0';\n    const numStr = dec === '0' || dec === '' ? val : `${val},${dec}`;\n    tlnAnswers[qStr] = numStr;\n\n    const expected = ((answerKey.tln || {})[qStr] || '').toString().replace(',','.');\n    const actual   = numStr.replace(',','.');\n    if (parseFloat(actual) === parseFloat(expected)) tlnCorrect++;\n  }\n\n  // Compute total score (THPTQG: 3+4+3 = 10)\n  const mcqScore = mcqTotal > 0 ? (mcqCorrect * 3.0 / mcqTotal) : 0;\n  const tfScore  = tfPoints; // already 0-4\n  const tlnScore = tlnTotal > 0 ? (tlnCorrect * 3.0 / tlnTotal) : 0;\n  const totalScore = (mcqScore + tfScore + tlnScore).toFixed(2);\n\n  return {\n    sbd:  sbdDigits.join(''),\n    made: madeDigits.join(''),\n    mcqCorrect, mcqTotal,\n    tfPoints: tfPoints.toFixed(2),\n    tfTotal,\n    tlnCorrect, tlnTotal,\n    score: totalScore,\n    mcqAnswers, tfAnswers, tlnAnswers,\n    timestamp: new Date().toLocaleString('vi-VN')\n  };\n}\n\n// Export for use in index.html\nwindow.OMREngine = { gradeOMR, findMarker, warpPerspective, readBubbleDarkness };\n","Description":"Pure JavaScript OMR engine with no dependencies: corner detection, homography computation, perspective warp, and bubble reading using Canvas 2D API only","Overwrite":false,"TargetFile":"/Users/admin/conictypst/sang-math-omr/js/omr_engine.js","toolAction":"Creating pure JS OMR engine","toolSummary":"Create omr_engine.js"}}]}
